product.olivetti-netstrada-3000.summary: The NetStrada with a Copper case that could be converted to rackmount.
product.olivetti-netstrada-3000.history: Olivetti documented the NetStrada 3000 on the Vulcan platform with a kit to mount the same case in a 19-inch rack.
product.olivetti-netstrada-3000.architec: The CPU and expansion slots share one board. The BA2315 uses Intel 440FX, Socket 8, three PCI slots and two ISA slots.
product.olivetti-netstrada-3000.verified: The configuration was checked against the cited sources. BluMach validation is pending.
product.olivetti-netstrada-3000.limitati: Firmware verification, boot tests and a photograph with clear publication rights are pending.
